name: Chang'e 5
intro: Ni hao! I'm Chang'e 5. My job: dig, drill, and send Moon rocks home.
Nobody has brought Moon samples to Earth since 1976!
We're going to Mons Rümker, a volcanic area with very YOUNG lava.
I work fast: two days on the surface and I'm off.
briefing: We are over Oceanus Procellarum, north of the equator.
Choose where we land for a two-day sampling job.
fact: Chang'e 5 brought 1.7 kg of samples: lava only about 2 billion years old, young for the Moon.
